title: RV & Boat Storage Rate Card: Monthly Space Rent
content:
**RV & Boat Storage — monthly rent by space class (USD)**

| Space class | Monthly rent |
|---|---|
| Open Compact Storage Space | 48.00 |
| Open Standard Storage Space | 72.00 |
| Open Large Storage Space | 94.00 |
| Covered Standard Storage Space | 128.00 |
| Covered Large Storage Space | 164.00 |
| Enclosed Storage Unit | 239.00 |

**Billing terms printed with the rate card (identical for all six classes)**

| Term | Every class |
|---|---|
| Period the rent covers | one calendar month |
| Day of the month the rent is due | the 1st (day 1) |
| Rent for the move-in month | charged by the actual days in that month |
| Rent for the move-out month | no proration: the full month is due and no partial month is refunded |
| Rounding of every computed charge and credit | half up, to the cent |

Notes to the rate card:

1. The monthly rent is a price per space per calendar month.
2. Because the move-out month carries no proration, a renter of the Covered Standard Storage Space who leaves partway through a month owes that month's full 128.00.
3. Half-up rounding to the cent means a computed amount whose third decimal place is 5 or more rounds up, and one whose third decimal place is 4 or less rounds down: a hypothetical computed charge of 70.195 becomes 70.20, and one of 70.194 becomes 70.19.
